items.summary: In `backend/main.mo`, add a second hardcoded admin seed account with username `admin` and password `Admin@1234` (role: `admin`) to both `system func init()` and `system func postupgrade()`. This account must be upserted into stable storage alongside the existing `genmitra` admin seed every time the canister is initialized or upgraded, so that logging in with username `admin` and password `Admin@1234` grants admin access.
